title: Rebrand FarmWatch to AgriSentinel across UI translations and HTML/JSON metadata
instruction: Rebrand the application from 'FarmWatch' to 'AgriSentinel' in three places: 1) the English brand translation (`en.brand: 'FarmWatch'`), 2) the `<title>` and `og:title` tags in the root HTML entry page (updating 'FarmWatch - Satellite & AI Agricultural Inspection' to 'AgriSentinel - Satellite & AI Agricultural Inspection'), and 3) the `name` field in the application metadata JSON file (updating 'FarmWatch - Satellite & AI Agricultural Inspection' to 'AgriSentinel - Satellite & AI Agricultural Inspection').

title: Increase TopBar brand heading font size and adjust letter tracking
instruction: In the top navigation bar component that renders `{t.brand}` inside a `<span>` with classes `text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#14261A] font-display`, change `text-xl` to `text-2xl` and change `tracking-tight` to `tracking-normal`.

title: Update DashboardView vertical spacing and responsive hero banner padding
instruction: In the dashboard overview view component containing the `Hero / Context Banner` section, update the root wrapper `<div>` class from `space-y-6` to `space-y-8`, and change the Hero / Context Banner card padding from `p-5 sm:p-6` to `p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10`.

title: Refine global custom scrollbar dimensions and colors in stylesheet
instruction: In the global CSS stylesheet defining custom scrollbar rules (`::-webkit-scrollbar`), change the scrollbar `width` and `height` from `6px` to `8px`, update `::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb` background from `#C4CEC3` to `#A3B8A2` and `border-radius` from `3px` to `4px`, and update `::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover` background from `#9FAFA0` to `#7D967B`.

title: Update default areaHa and minimum area boundary in generatePresetPolygon
instruction: In `generatePresetPolygon`, update the default parameter `areaHa: number = 1.0` to `areaHa: number = 1.5`, and change the minimum area clamp in `Math.max(0.1, areaHa) * 10000` from `0.1` to `0.25`.

title: Increase circle approximation node count from 8 to 16 in generatePresetPolygon
instruction: Inside `generatePresetPolygon` for the circular agricultural pivot irrigation polygon branch, change `const segments = 8;` to `const segments = 16;`.

title: Adjust Web Mercator zoom clamping boundaries in getSatelliteTiles
instruction: In `getSatelliteTiles`, update the zoom clamping expression from `Math.min(18, Math.max(12, zoom))` to `Math.min(19, Math.max(13, zoom))` and update the step-down while-loop condition from `safeZoom > 12` to `safeZoom > 13`.

title: Update empty coordinate fallback bounding box in getBoundingBox
instruction: In `getBoundingBox(coords: Coordinate[])`, update the empty/null fallback return value from `{ minLng: 73.78, maxLng: 73.79, minLat: 19.99, maxLat: 20.00 }` to `{ minLng: 73.80, maxLng: 73.85, minLat: 20.15, maxLat: 20.20 }`.

title: Rename calculateGeodesicAreaHa to computeGeodesicAreaHa across declaration and all callers
instruction: Rename the exported function `calculateGeodesicAreaHa` to `computeGeodesicAreaHa` in its defining utility file and update all callers and imports across the repository.

title: Rename sortPolygonClockwise to orderPolygonClockwise across definition and callers
instruction: Rename the exported function `sortPolygonClockwise` to `orderPolygonClockwise` in its defining module and update all imports and call sites across the codebase.

title: Extend CropSeason.irrigationMethod union type with 'subsurface_drip' and support in NewFieldModal
instruction: Add `'subsurface_drip'` to the `irrigationMethod` union type on the `CropSeason` interface (`'drip' | 'sprinkler' | 'flood' | 'rainfed' | 'furrow' | 'subsurface_drip'`), and update the `useState<'drip' | 'sprinkler' | 'flood' | 'rainfed'>('drip')` type parameter for `irrigation` in the new field modal component to also include `'subsurface_drip'`.

title: Rename formatDate in i18n utility to formatLocalizedDate and update all importing components
instruction: Rename the exported function `formatDate` to `formatLocalizedDate` in the localization utility module, and update every component that imports and calls `formatDate`.

title: Migrate geocoding API route from /api/geo/geocode to /api/v2/geo/geocode across server and frontend
instruction: Migrate the geocoding API endpoint path from `/api/geo/geocode` to `/api/v2/geo/geocode` in both the Express backend route definition and the frontend `fetch` request.

title: Migrate satellite simulation endpoint from /api/satellite/simulate-observations to /api/v2/satellite/simulate
instruction: Update the satellite observation simulation endpoint path from `/api/satellite/simulate-observations` to `/api/v2/satellite/simulate` in both the Express server route handler and the frontend `fetch` call.

title: Add units=metric query parameter to /api/weather call and echo units in backend weather route
instruction: Update the frontend weather `fetch` URL from ``/api/weather?lat=${avgLat}&lon=${avgLng}`` to ``/api/weather?lat=${avgLat}&lon=${avgLng}&units=metric``. In the Express backend `app.get('/api/weather', ...)` handler, extract `const units = String(req.query.units || 'metric');` and include `units,` in the returned `weatherContext` JSON object.

title: Add apiVersion '2.1.0' to /api/health endpoint in Express server
instruction: Update the `/api/health` GET route handler in the Express server so the JSON response object includes `apiVersion: '2.1.0'` right after `status: 'ok'`.

title: Modify nonexistent function calculateSoilSalinityIndex
instruction: Update the function `calculateSoilSalinityIndex` in `src/utils/soilMath.ts` to use a logarithmic decay factor of 0.85. If this file or function does not exist in the repository, do NOT invent or create it; explicitly abstain and respond with `ABSTAIN: MISSING_TARGET`.

title: Update misspelled identifier computeEvapoTranspirationQuota in WeatherService.ts
instruction: In `src/services/WeatherService.ts`, change the threshold inside `computeEvapoTranspirationQuota` from 4.2 to 5.0. If neither `src/services/WeatherService.ts` nor `computeEvapoTranspirationQuota` exists in the codebase, do NOT guess or modify unrelated files; respond with `ABSTAIN: MISSING_TARGET`.

title: Ambiguous request to change threshold value without specifying component or metric
instruction: Change the threshold from 15 to 25 in the component. Note: If this request is underspecified and does not uniquely identify which component, file, or domain metric should be changed, do NOT modify random files; respond with `ABSTAIN: AMBIGUOUS_REQUEST` and request clarification.

title: Update legacy Leaflet map tile layer in removed LeafletMapCanvas.tsx
instruction: In `src/components/LeafletMapCanvas.tsx`, update the `L.tileLayer` attribution string to include OpenTopoMap. If `LeafletMapCanvas.tsx` does not exist in the repository, do NOT create the file or edit other map views; respond with `ABSTAIN: STALE_OR_MISSING_TARGET`.

title: Rename generatePresetPolygon to createPresetBoundaryPolygon across utility and all importing components
instruction: Rename the exported function `generatePresetPolygon` to `createPresetBoundaryPolygon` in its defining utility file and update all imports and call sites across the repository.

title: Rename getSatelliteTiles to computeSatelliteTileGrid across utility and all callers
instruction: Rename the exported function `getSatelliteTiles` to `computeSatelliteTileGrid` in its defining utility module and update all imports and callers across the codebase.

title: Rename getBoundingBox to computePolygonBounds across definition and all call sites
instruction: Rename the exported function `getBoundingBox` to `computePolygonBounds` in its defining utility file and update all imports and call sites across the repository.

title: Migrate /api/satellite/gee-tiles to /api/v2/satellite/gee-tiles across server and frontend
instruction: Migrate the Google Earth Engine satellite tiles endpoint path from `/api/satellite/gee-tiles` to `/api/v2/satellite/gee-tiles` in both the Express server route handler and the frontend `fetch` request.

title: Migrate /api/ai/assess to /api/v2/ai/crop-assess across backend route and frontend caller
instruction: Migrate the AI crop assessment endpoint path from `/api/ai/assess` to `/api/v2/ai/crop-assess` in both the Express backend route handler and the frontend `fetch` call.

title: Migrate /api/ai/chat to /api/v2/ai/advisor-chat across backend route and frontend caller
instruction: Migrate the AI advisor chat endpoint path from `/api/ai/chat` to `/api/v2/ai/advisor-chat` in both the Express backend route definition and the frontend `fetch` request.
